propositions: ADR 0100 must record the approved design for a stdlib-only immutable lazy command registry with module:function references and bounded invocation adapters, replacing repeated CLI censuses with shared route/capability authority.
Parser-derived help must be generated from a single stdlib argparse factory source used for both runtime parsing and committed package help, with deterministic prog/width/formatter generation.

Pre-operation help/alias/unknown routing must execute before RP-04 snapshot, config, mount, handlers, or optional imports, enforcing the routing boundary between lexical selection and handler argument parsing.

The capability registry must map semantic capabilities to error/unavailable/abstain/fallback postures and enforced-only-after-handler-selection routing, with no plugin framework, Click dependency, or middleware framework.
ADR 0100 generated artifacts (index, markers) must pass scripts/check_adr_numbers.py and scripts/gen_adr_index.py --check validation, with no contradiction to ADR 0098 or existing CLI ADRs.
The maintainer-approved exact ADR draft must receive explicit approval via tracker comment after draft critique resolves all unverified assumptions and dependencies before Gerrit Submit.
